description: Defines enumerations and utility methods for handling common enumeration types such as period frequency, condition types, days in month/year, used across the Fineract project.

classes.name: CommonEnumerations
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to convert enumeration types to EnumOptionData objects for use in UI or other representations.

methods.name: commonEnumueration
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for a given type name and id, either daysInMonthType or daysInYearType.

methods.name: termFrequencyType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for a given PeriodFrequencyType or its integer representation, with a code prefix.

methods.name: conditionType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for a given ConditionType or its integer representation, with a code prefix.

methods.name: conditionType (array)
methods.description: Converts an array of ConditionType to a list of EnumOptionData, excluding invalid types.

methods.name: daysInMonthType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for a given DaysInMonthType or its integer representation.

methods.name: daysInYearType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for a given DaysInYearType or its integer representation.
